subject: Proposed evaluation onramp + prompt matrix & kickoff times
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@brightly.com>, Mike Huang <mike.huang@brightly.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed evaluation onramp + prompt matrix & kickoff times

Hi Ellen and Mike —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our discovery: Brightly wants to validate an LLM assistant for product recommendations across web + mobile with tight latency (p95 < 200ms) and cost targets aligned to ~0.03 USD per 1k tokens for inference. Primary success criteria we heard:

- Precision on top-3 recommendations >= 85% on your QA set
- Average response latency p95 < 200ms in us-west region
- Cost per active session below the threshold above

Next step I suggest is an evaluation kickoff (45–60m) with a short technical deep dive and agreement on the prompt set we’ll use for quality measurement. Proposed slots (Pacific time):

- Thu Dec 3, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Thu Dec 3, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Fri Dec 4, 14:00–14:45 PT

I’ve attached a short Redwood Eval Playbook that outlines the proposed trial cadence, and a Mutual Action Plan template. Could you confirm which slot works and whether you want Marcus (runtime/ops) or Neha (solutions) to join the technical segment? Also: if you can share an initial prompt set CSV (or we can use the attached prompt_set_template.csv) before the kickoff, we’ll map evaluation metrics to your QA cases.

Attachments: Redwood_Eval_Playbook.pdf, prompt_set_template.csv, Brightly_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@brightly.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Huang <mike.huang@brightly.com>, procurement@brightly.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation onramp + prompt matrix & kickoff times

Thanks Vanessa — great summary. Mike and I reviewed the times and the Dec 3 10:00–10:45 PT slot works best for us. Please schedule that.

A couple clarifications before the kickoff:

1) For success criteria, can you confirm whether Redwood can instrument token-level cost and p95 latency during the trial (we need both metrics in the MAP).
2) We need a short list of example prompts you recommend for recommendation recall vs. personalization tests (so we can map to our QA cases).
3) SOC 2 evidence is a requirement for procurement — can you share the SOC 2 report or an authorization link before the trial kicks off?

I’ll loop procurement if we need a PO or contract ahead of the run. For now they just wanted to be kept in the thread.

Thanks — see you Thu at 10am PT.

Ellen Park
Head of Product, Brightly Retail
ellen.park@brightly.com | +1 (312) 555-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@brightly.com>, Mike Huang <mike.huang@brightly.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation onramp + prompt matrix & kickoff times

Perfect — I’ve put Dec 3, 10:00–10:45 PT on the calendar and sent a calendar invite to the thread. Marcus will join for the ops deep dive and Neha will run the evaluation design portion.

Quick answers to your questions:

1) Instrumentation: yes — during the trial Redwood will surface token-level cost, per-request latency (p50/p95), and token breakdowns in the console. We’ll add a short dashboard tile for the MAP so procurement can review.
2) Prompt examples: attaching prompt_set_template.csv — we recommend three categories for the kickoff:
   - Cold-recall prompts (canonical product lookup),
   - Contextual personalization prompts (user profile + browsing history), and
   - Edge/failure prompts (ambiguous or incomplete queries).

We’ll populate the template with 10 seed prompts ahead of the meeting if you can share a small sample of your QA cases (CSV or sheet).

3) SOC 2: I’ve attached a link to our SOC 2 summary in the shared drive (see related links). If procurement needs the full report we can get it to them under an NDA — Marcus can help coordinate that.

Agenda for the 45m kickoff:
- 00–10m: Introductions & goals (Vanessa)
- 10–25m: Tech/ops run-through (Marcus)
- 25–40m: Eval design, prompt matrix & measurement plan (Neha)
- 40–45m: Action items and timeline (All)

Attachments: Brightly_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, prompt_set_template.csv

If that all looks good I’ll finalize the MAP and drop a pre-kickoff checklist in the Drive folder.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
